summary: SU Group Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary, SU Group Investment Limited, completed the previously announced acquisition of 100% of the equity interests in KM Safety Solution Company Limited from seller Lead New Limited, under a sale and purchase agreement announced September 15, 2026. Aggregate all-cash consideration was HK$5,616,000 (approximately US$721,000 at HK$7.78/US$1.00). KM provides safety solutions and consultancy and holds Hong Kong distribution rights for intelligent emergency lighting control products under a 24-month agreement. No board recommendation or advisor was named; the deal closed October 2, 2026. Watch integration execution, added revenue, and limited near-term financial disclosure.
